item.text: The value object now has a more standard sequence-style API, and the demo can consume command-line input instead of only a baked-in example. I’m doing a quick correctness pass on the iterator and then compiling/running both the default and argument-driven flows.
Compilation passed. I’m running the demo in both modes now so the refactor is verified against the old sample path and the new CLI path.

Refactored the remaining public API around a more standard sequence model.

[prefixsum/PrefixSumArray.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/003_prefix_sum_array/prefixsum/PrefixSumArray.java:1) now implements `Iterable<Integer>`, adds `size()` and `isEmpty()`, reuses a shared empty instance, and uses `StringJoiner` for formatting. I also fixed the iterator contract so `next()` throws `NoSuchElementException` instead of falling through to an array bounds error.

[prefixsum/PrefixSumDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/003_prefix_sum_array/prefixsum/PrefixSumDemo.java:1) now accepts command-line integers, with the old sample values as a fallback. Verification passed with `javac prefixsum/*.java`, `java prefixsum.PrefixSumDemo`, and `java prefixsum.PrefixSumDemo 3 1 4 1 5`.
